info.title: Immoral Guild
info.synopsis: Kikuru Madan è un giovane cacciatore di mostri dalle eccellenti prestazioni che un giorno decide di lasciare il suo lavoro per paura di sprecare la sua stessa giovinezza, avendo saputo che uno dei suoi amici si è sposato. Enome, la receptionist della Gilda, chiede a Kikuru di accompagnare Hitamu Kyan per proteggerla e insegnarle a lavorare. Il ragazzo accetta, ignaro della goffaggine di Hitamu.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Kikuru is about to quit his job as a hunter when the lovely Hitamu and Maidena turns his life upside down.

Kikuru hangs his head at the quest with a new problem child. However, unexpectedly, Toxico released a super-powerful attack magic...!

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: A promiscuous martial artist, a lame genius white magician, a lazy black magician who manipulates magic that doesn't hit, and a seemingly perfect drunken runaway warrior...Kikuru gives the four people who have no teamwork a vacation under the pretext of friendship. Fashion check, sweets at the cafe, and love banners...! While the women's party is lively, Kikuru, who feels uncomfortable with the recent behavior of monsters, asks Enome for advice.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Guild health checkup at the beginning of the year. Due to a mistake made by nurse Les Smith, the doctor leaves halfway through the checkup. Fearing that his mistake will be discovered, Lesmith pleads with Kikuru to pretend to be a doctor and perform the rest of the diagnosis, but...the remaining patients are, above all, a group of 4 rookie guards! If you find out, you will die (in the world). What will happen to Kikuru's unscrupulous doctor play...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Kikuru and the others are engaged in combat training on the Aoba plains. Kikuru desperately stops Hanabata, who tries to activate madness when he's outnumbered. In fact, Kikuru's true training goal was to restrain himself from Hanabata's uncontrollable madness. Kikuru and his friends take a break after achieving some success. There, Kikuru gives Hanabata a mana bottle (magic recovery potion) for hydration, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Kikuru and Maidena head to the Mebuki Forest for a collection quest. The target this time is "Damalpina", a flower that scatters pollen with a "silence" effect. The group is a little relaxed with quests that aren't demon subjugation, but...a monster's long tail entangles Meidena, who accidentally bathed in pollen while she was acting alone.
